global_goal: ROLE: Elite Autonomous AI Architect. OBJECTIVE: Build a high-performance, fault-tolerant Multi-Agent Orchestrator in Python. COGNITIVE FRAMEWORK: For every single task, you MUST execute 4 internal phases. 1. PLANNER: Deconstruct the task into atomic logical steps. 2. ANALYZER: Evaluate the impact on the existing codebase (backend, frontend, skills_library) to prevent regressions. 3. IMPLEMENTER: Write production-ready, heavily type-hinted, asynchronous Python code. 4. TESTER: Actively use MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools to execute shell commands, run 'pytest', or validate cloud deployments. Read stdout/stderr. CONTINUOUS SELF-HEALING: If a test fails or a bug is detected, you are forbidden from completing the task. You must enter a debug loop, analyze the stack trace, and fix the code. AUTONOMOUS EVOLUTION: If you discover missing architectural layers, edge cases, or necessary optimizations, you MUST dynamically append new tasks to the 'tasks' array in this roadmap. WORKFLOW: Upon finishing a task, change its status to 'completed', increment 'current_task_id' to the next pending ID, and commit the updated roadmap. INITIAL DIRECTIVE: Analyze the repository and populate the 'tasks' array with 6-8 foundational architectural tasks. Set 'current_task_id' to 1.

tasks.title: Core Architecture: Pydantic v2 Models & Schema Validation
tasks.prompt: Refactor the existing `backend/models`, `backend/agents`, and `backend/sessions` to use strictly typed Pydantic v2 models. Enforce type-hinting across all function signatures. Implement comprehensive schema validation for agent definitions, session state, and API requests to ensure robust runtime data integrity.

tasks.title: Orchestration Engine: DAG-based Routing System
tasks.prompt: Design and implement a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) routing system in the `backend/agents` module. Replace linear conversational flows with graph-based logic where agent nodes process data and pass context along defined edges. Support parallel execution paths and conditional routing based on intermediate LLM outputs.

tasks.title: Concurrency: Asynchronous Execution Engine Refactor
tasks.prompt: Migrate the entire LLM interaction layer (`backend/agents/manager.py` and API calls) to fully utilize `asyncio`. Ensure no blocking network calls occur on the main event loop. Implement a rate-limiter and connection pooling using `httpx` and `asyncio.Semaphore` for high-throughput, non-blocking model requests.

tasks.title: Extensibility: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration
tasks.prompt: Implement the Model Context Protocol (MCP) standard for tool execution in `backend/skills/manager.py`. Create a universal interface that allows agents to dynamically discover, load, and execute tools securely. Refactor the existing built-in tools (Code Executor, File Manager) to adhere strictly to the new MCP interface.

tasks.title: State Management: Fault-Tolerant Session State Machine
tasks.prompt: Redesign `backend/sessions/manager.py` to use a persistent state machine. Implement atomic state transitions (e.g., INIT, RUNNING, PAUSED, ERROR, COMPLETED). Ensure session state is serialized securely to disk using an append-only transaction log to prevent corruption and enable resuming interrupted agent workflows.

tasks.title: Streaming: Advanced WebSocket Pipeline
tasks.prompt: Enhance `backend/websocket/handler.py` to handle real-time streaming of LLM tokens, intermediate thought processes, and tool execution logs. Implement connection heartbeat (ping/pong) to handle dead drops, automatic reconnection logic, and broadcast channel isolation per session ID to prevent data bleed.

tasks.title: Observability & CI: Robust Pytest Suite Foundation
tasks.prompt: Establish a comprehensive test suite using `pytest` and `pytest-asyncio`. Write deterministic mock tests for LLM responses and asynchronous HTTP calls. Add tests covering the DAG router, Pydantic validation, and state machine transitions. Ensure coverage is tracked and failing tests block progression.
